bull_case: AI-enabled search and higher-resolution Pelican can expand wallet share inside existing customers.
bear_case: Large contracts and services work can create concentration and lower-margin implementation requirements.
thesis: Customer value is increasingly measurable: NDR above 100%, near-total recurring ACV, and defense/government expansion show that imagery is embedded in workflows rather than purchased as one-off content.

evidence.claim: Q2 GAAP gross margin was 57% and adjusted EBITDA +$13.9M.

counterevidence: Satellite services can raise revenue growth while also increasing hardware, launch and execution intensity versus pure imagery subscriptions.
unknowns: Normalized satellite-services gross margin, long-run owner FCF/share, and customer concentration after current sovereign contract ramp.
falsifiers: If NDR falls below 100%, RPO/backlog contract materially, or owner FCF/share turns persistently negative despite revenue growth, the thesis is downgraded.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Growth is supported by renewal, NDR and contracted government demand rather than marketing/subsidy dependence.
